run_create_coco_data_files: run the script to extract COCO2014 dataset files and labels from annotations for training splits
run_clip_xyxy_to_image: run clip_xyxy_to_image to clip bounding box coordinates to an image's height and width bounds
run_get_valid_objs: run get_valid_objs to filter COCO annotation objects by ignoring flagged and zero-area entries
run_get_imgs_labels_info: run get_imgs_labels_info to extract image paths and binary label vectors from a COCO JSON annotation file
run_main: run main to process all COCO2014 partitions and save image paths and labels as numpy files
